comments.text: Love how you romanticized my country! You show some beautiful footage! Too bad that a lot of the story doesn't match with the visuals. Also, the segment from 4:56 to 5:31 is not Suriname. You show a market that is in Nickerie, another district, as we call them in Suriname (think of it as a city), while talking about Paramaribo. They are not the same. And why do you show a funeral when talking about how multicultural Suriname is? This is not a good travel video and doesn't put my country in the beautiful light it deserves. This woud have been a better documentary, with better visuals and less repeating of the same.
